cells.gaps: No source found says a rule requires mobile money providers and banks to connect to each other or to a switch. An MTN executive said in September 2026 there is no dedicated non-bank mobile money licence (ZAF-002), while the Reserve Bank lists non-banks designated under the Act.
cells.note: The National Payment System Act 1998 is in force and the Reserve Bank has designated non-banks such as Yoco (2021) and Payfast (2024) as clearing system participants under it. Nothing found shows a rule requiring providers to connect, which stage 5 needs.
